newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Supply acquires Wholesale Electric.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Supply acquires Wholesale Electric.

text.p: Hughes Supply Inc said it had signed an agreement with the shareholders of Wholesale Electric Supply Corp to acquire the company for an undisclosed number of its shares.
Hughes, which expected the deal to close by November 30, said the acquisition would likely be accretive to earnings per share on an annualised basis.
Wholesale Electric is a distributor of electrical products based in Vestal, New York. Its sales for its fiscal year ended December 31, 1995, were about $25 million.
Hughes distributes construction and industrial supplies.
